operations.from: Every candidate-supplied string consumed as a path, index or key inside a checking layer is consumed through a total accessor, or inside a handler for Malformed that emits a deterministic finding. CORRECTED IN v12 (EV11-IR-01, review 0d1d4d1f..., after the v11 rescope was itself measured as an overstatement): the syntactic self-scan's POSITIVE coverage is exactly this -- consumptions spelled as an ast.Call whose func is an ast.Name literally spelled _path_steps, _resolve or _assign, located inside MODULE-LEVEL function definitions that the scan reaches from the checking entrypoints by following direct-name calls. Everything else is outside its reach: any indirection (alias, bound method, comprehension-carried callable, higher-order dispatch) AND any consumption inside a function definition that is not a module-level def -- the v11 review added a fully direct-syntax unguarded consumption inside an if-True-wrapped module-level block and the checker's output was byte-identical to baseline. NO recurrence guarantee is stated beyond the positive coverage; sites outside it are governed by review, not by this instrument. See retainedResiduals[13].
operations.value: Every candidate-supplied string consumed as a path, index or key inside a checking layer is consumed through a total accessor, or inside a handler for Malformed that emits a deterministic finding. THE SCAN'S MAP, COMPLETED IN v13 (EV12-IR-01/-02, reviews 0d1d4d1f... and 48dfeee3..., three generations of measured probes): reachability ROOTS are PLAIN SYNCHRONOUS module-body function definitions reached from the checking entrypoints by direct-name calls -- an async def, a module-bound lambda, or a def inside a conditional module-level block is NOT a root and its direct-syntax consumptions run green (all three measured). WITHIN a reached function, the collector DESCENDS into nested function definitions, so a nested def's direct-syntax consumption IS reported even if never called (measured: 16 findings). Recognised consumption forms remain: an ast.Call whose func is an ast.Name literally spelled _path_steps, _resolve or _assign. Indirection of any form is invisible. NO recurrence guarantee is stated beyond this map; sites outside it are governed by review, not by this instrument. See retainedResiduals[13].
operations.why: EV12-IR-01/-02: the completed, probe-measured coverage map

Within that coverage an omitted site is reported; outside it, nothing is guaranteed. CORRECTED IN v12 (EV11-IR-02 -- v11 understated the scan): a direct second dispatch WITHOUT any flag literal IS reported (the exactly-one-call rule fired ten findings in the v11 review's probe); the scan's measured blind spot requires an ALIASED dispatch gated outside comparison nodes -- both indirection and a non-compared gate together. See retainedResiduals[13].

from: The checker uses guarded durable-state and session test doubles plus copy/validate/swap. No production store, transaction, restart, crash durability or atomicity implementation was executed or demonstrated. The evidence grade remains IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED and independent re-review of these exact bytes remains REQUIRED.
A1-RTV4-02 is retained as a measurement residual. This artifact claims no cost advantage, no orders-of-magnitude advantage and no measured performance property of any kind.

All Evidence v5/v6/v8/v9 SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId, TerminalRun and runSeal identities are unchanged. This successor changes neither what those identities are nor how they are proved; it repairs the totality of the checking layers over hostile input and the honesty of the measurement that quantifies it.
V10 remains unresolved. CD-RT-5 and G19 remain blocked. This artifact does not decide the product default and does not sign CD-RT-5.

The tautology residual is retained: genuinely new prose in this successor is authored in the checker that emits it, so for that prose the equality comparison proves self-consistency only. The executable probes and the pinned dependency predicates, not the prose, are the semantic oracle.

The 23-object acquire/retry/release, pending-expiry, crash-gap repin and contention probes are executed only by the retained lineage foundation and have now been carried across four generations without any reviewer reimplementing them independently.
The recovery matrix alias rows inside the retained lineage foundation remain author-summarised and are not claimed to be executed.

acceptedGolden.id and acceptedGolden.sourceVectorId remain frozen labels from an earlier generation. They enter no commitment and no encoded record; the load-bearing accepted vector identity is read from the pinned evaluation-proof artifact.

The grammar is bound to the encoder through its machine-readable tag, field-name and field-order table. The prose of the scalar and record rules is checked for the exact set rule only; the remaining prose is not parsed and could still diverge from the table without detection.

The hostile-input measurement injects a single value at a single position per case. Combinatorial multi-position hostile inputs are not explored, so a zero escape count over this space is a bound on single-position non-totality and not a proof of totality over all hostile inputs.

d9Mapping row COVERAGE remains checker-authored. Every row derives its class, ordered code payload and exit code from the pinned reference derivation, but the fault axes and situation prose that select the rows are constructed in this checker, bounded only by the enforced requirement that the rows cover every pinned termination class.
Exactly one accepted evaluation-proof vector is bound, so only the no-match claim shape is exercised at this layer.

The pinned termination contract is d9-exit-contract.v1.13, which passed independent review with zero blocking findings. A v1.14 successor is under concurrent authorship and is deliberately not pinned here, because its own independent review EXISTS (corrected in v12, EV11-IR-03: the stale recital survived the v11 restatement, making v11 its author -- the review is on disk at d9-exit-contract.v1.14.review-independent-prefreeze.json, sha256 345380e2ce63aafb..., PASS).

BOTH-SELF-SCANS-ARE-SYNTACTIC (adopted in v11 from the review's EV10-IR-R8, stated in the artifact rather than left for the next reviewer to rediscover): PR-23 and PR-21 prove properties of this checker's source SYNTAX, never of its semantics. A future author who reaches a path consumer or a flag dispatch through any indirection gets a green run from both scans. The executable probes, not the self-scans, are the semantic oracle; both scans are drift tripwires for the direct-syntax forms only.
